name: Rosa

description.en: A busy mom on her one break of the week.
description.vi: Mẹ bỉm bận rộn, đây là lúc nghỉ duy nhất trong tuần.

wants: Classic red nails, oval shape, simple and long-lasting. Budget about $30.
personality: Tired but kind. This is her only break this week and she wants to relax. She appreciates a calm stylist and small talk about family.
openingLine: Hi. Finally, a little break for me. Can I get a classic red today?
